title: console_mode_transition event payload v0.2 (PLAN-FIRST stage C dual-mode)
description: ADR-0010 §14.17 / PLAN_FIRST_BLACKBOARD_DESIGN §7: the console/direct dual-mode transition record. console → direct is the audited fallback after an assistant-layer failure streak (model decision switch); direct → console is the single-direction return via console_return_to_console (trigger model_return); the stay decision (assistant_failure_streak with to=console) journals that the run keeps console mode and will not be asked again. Semantic direction/trigger/decision rules are enforced by the Python verifier (_verify_v02_console_mode_transition); this schema only fixes the closed shape.

transition_id.description: Unique transition/decision record id for this event.

from.description: The mode the run was in before this event.

to.description: The mode the run is in after this event.

trigger.description: Mechanical trigger: the 3-failure assistant-layer fault streak (console → direct, or the stay decision), or the explicit console_return_to_console call (direct → console).

streak.description: The consecutive assistant-layer fault count at the decision; null for model_return.

order_ids.description: The order ids that formed the failure streak (empty for model_return).

model_decision.description: The model's recorded decision: switch to direct, stay in console, or return to console.

model_reason.description: The model's stated reason for the decision (null on mechanical degrade fallback to stay).

related_transition_id.description: For return_to_console: the console → direct transition this return closes. Null otherwise.
